verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform, and a built-in assistant in its console or docs is a plausible feature, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only API primitives: chat completions, tool use, remote MCP orchestration and the Responses API. These are developer building blocks for building agents, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to inside the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
